```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary) #summarytables
library(ggpubr) #combining figures

```

# Input data
```{r, echo = TRUE}
main_directory <- ""  

#Summary sleep statistics (architecture)
fname_sleepstats <- paste(main_directory, 'sleepstatistics_allsubs_acq_eeg.csv', sep="")
dat_archit <- read.csv(fname_sleepstats)

#Collect TMR logfiles
BEH_directory <- ""
all_files <- list.files(BEH_directory, pattern = NULL, full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)

# Filter files that contain both "task-sleep" and "sleepstages.csv"
filtered_files <- all_files[grepl("task-sleep", all_files) & grepl("sleepstages.csv", all_files)]

```

# Combine participant data for TMR logs
```{r}
# Loop over individual files
combined_logs <- data.frame()
for (file in filtered_files) {
  # Read the CSV file, assuming it has a header
  data <- read.csv(file)
  
  # Extract 'subid' from the filename; adjust the extraction logic as needed
  subid <- unlist(strsplit(file, "/"))[12] 

  # Add a column for 'subid' and set it to the extracted 'subid'
  data$subid <- subid
  
  # Combine the current data with the combined data
  combined_logs <- rbind(combined_logs, data)
}
```

```{r}
#Exclude participants (no TMR)
noTMR_ids = c('sub-XXX', 
            'sub-XXX', 
            'sub-XXX', 
            'sub-XXX', 
            'sub-XXX',
            'sub-XXX', 
            'sub-XXX', 
            'sub-XXX',
            'sub-XXX',
            'sub-XXX') #discard only from sleep architecutre, first half of the night not recorded

disc_sub_ind <- which(dat_archit$subid %in% noTMR_ids)
dat_archit <- dat_archit[-disc_sub_ind,]

disc_sub_ind <- which(combined_logs$subid %in% noTMR_ids)
combined_logs <- combined_logs[-disc_sub_ind,]

```

# Unit transformations
```{r}
dat_archit <- dat_archit %>% 
  mutate(TST_hours = TST/60,
         TRT_hours = TRT/60) 
```

# Group statistics: sleep architecture
```{r}
dat_archit %>% select(3:18) %>% 
  tbl_summary(
    statistic = list(        # Specify summary statistics for variables
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",  # For continuous variables
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"      # For categorical variables
    )
  )
#print(summary_table)
```

# Architecture visualization
```{r}
#histogram: total sleep time
hist_TST <- dat_archit %>% ggplot(aes(x=TST_hours)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  xlab("total sleep  time (h)")

#histogram: sleep latency
hist_SL <- dat_archit %>% ggplot(aes(x=SL)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  xlab("sleep latency (min)")

#histogram: swake after sleep onsest
hist_WASO <- dat_archit %>% ggplot(aes(x=WASO)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  xlab("wake after sleep onset (min)")

#histogram: sleep efficiency
hist_SE <- dat_archit %>% ggplot(aes(x=SE)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  xlab("sleep efficency (%)")

ggarrange(hist_TST,
          hist_SL,
          hist_WASO,
          hist_SE)

```

# Single trials per stage
```{r}
#Visualize TMR distribution by stage
combined_logs %>% ggplot(aes(x=sleepstage)) +
  geom_histogram()

#Summarize 
combined_logs %>% 
  group_by(sleepstage) %>% 
  summarise(n_TMR = n(),
            perc_TMR = (n_TMR/dim(combined_logs)[1])*100
            )

```
 # Sleep stage confidence
```{r}
combined_logs <- combined_logs %>% 
  mutate(hits = ifelse(sleepstage == 2 | sleepstage == 3, "yes", "no"))

#Confidence by hit/miss
combined_logs %>% 
  group_by(hits) %>% 
  summarise(mean_conf = mean(sleepstage_confidence),
            med_conf = median(sleepstage_confidence),
            min_conf = min(sleepstage_confidence),
            max.conf = max(sleepstage_confidence)
  )
  
#Confidence by sleep stage
combined_logs %>% 
  group_by(sleepstage) %>% 
  summarise(mean_conf = mean(sleepstage_confidence),
            med_conf = median(sleepstage_confidence),
            min_conf = min(sleepstage_confidence),
            max.conf = max(sleepstage_confidence)
  )
  

#Histograms by sleep stage
combined_logs %>% 
  filter(hits == "yes") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=sleepstage_confidence)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  facet_grid(~sleepstage)


combined_logs %>% 
  filter(hits == "no") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=sleepstage_confidence)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  facet_grid(~sleepstage)

```
